# Ojak

> A local macOS menu bar and Windows tray app for managing your own Claude Code and Codex subscription accounts. Unofficial, early preview; no provider-limit bypass.

## Installation

- [Agent installation guide](https://github.com/lapalai/ojak/blob/main/docs/install-for-agents.md): Supported platforms, safe installation, account setup, optional omp integration, and verification with `aam setup --check`.
- [Latest public release](https://github.com/lapalai/ojak/releases/latest): macOS Apple silicon DMG and Windows x64 installer.
